sent_to_model:
Ok I'm actually so over this company. I ordered craft stuff for my class with my OWN money from Tiny Hands Edu Supplies and the courier says it was delivered but it never arrived at school. Now they're telling me to sort it out with the courier?? Like no, I paid you. Please write me an email to their customer service, I want them to know I'm cross but I don't want to sound like a crazy person either. I need either the stuff or my money back, not another 'we've escalated your query'. Order number and all the details are below.

- order TH-48217, placed 21 Oct, paid R1,640 incl R95 delivery, card payment
- 6 tubs finger paint, 4 bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, googly eyes, glitter glue, 2 rolls of brown paper
- tracking said delivered Tues 3 Nov 11:42, signed "M. Adams"
- nobody at the school called Adams, gate guard Uncle Faizel keeps a book of every delivery, nothing on the 3rd
- school is Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead, delivery address was correct on the order
- emailed 4 Nov, 6 Nov, got the same copy paste reply both times, "we have escalated your query to our courier partner"
- phoned Friday, 38 min on hold, lady said she can't do anything until courier finishes "investigation", could take 10 working days
- kids already made the masks pattern last week, been telling them the paint is "coming soon" for a week
- my contract is with them not the courier, I never chose the courier
- not fair that I'm out of pocket R1,640 on a teacher's salary for stuff for other people's kids
- used them 3 times before with no issue, which is why this is so annoying
- resend the order OR full refund incl delivery, by Fri 13 Nov
- end of year concert is 27 Nov, need the stuff for the props
- someone to actually reply to me properly, not a template
- if no answer will do a chargeback with my bank and leave a review

(About me: kindergarten teacher, 26, Cape Town, South Africa. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

must_cover: Explains the missing delivery and unsuccessful contacts with customer service.
Requests resending the order or a full refund including delivery by Friday 13 November.
Explains that the supplies are needed for props for the end-of-year concert on 27 November.
Requests a substantive customer-service reply rather than another template escalation.
States that, if no answer is received, the sender will pursue a bank chargeback and leave a review.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
